newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman first quarter oil exports rise 5.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Oman first quarter oil exports rise 5.8 pct.

text.p: Oman's crude oil exports in the first quarter of 1997 rose to 76.291 million barrels from 72.120 million in the year-ago period, the official Oman News agency said on Friday.

The agency, quoting a ministry of development report, said China was the biggest importer of Omani crude in the quarter, with imports of about 20.782 million barrels, sharply up from 9.491 million in the first quarter of 1996.
Japan came second, with imports of 20.202 million barrels, down from 25.046 million the previous year. Thailand was the third largest importer at 17.118 million barrels, up from 13.193 million.
The report said the average price of Omani oil rose to $20.44 per barrel in the first quarter from $17.18 in the first three months of 1996.
